units.source_text: 大概大竹七段早已有所警惕，正面对付秀哉名人的拿手招数是危险的。

en.t: Ōtake 7-dan had probably been on guard for some time, knowing that it was dangerous to meet Master Shūsai's favorite tactics head-on.

units.source_text: 因而他极力避免卷入大范围的战斗和难解难分的乱战，

en.t: Therefore he did all he could to avoid being drawn into large-scale fighting and tangled, hard-to-resolve melees,

units.source_text: 竭力缩小名人的作战余地，另一方面努力争取把棋局引向自己拿手的模式。

en.t: striving to narrow the Master's room for maneuver while at the same time trying to steer the game toward patterns in which he himself excelled.

units.source_text: 虽然让白占领大场，也是为了牢固地站稳脚跟。

en.t: Even when he allowed White to take the big points, it was in order to secure a firm foothold.

units.source_text: 这种坚实的着法不是消极的，而且潜藏着积极的因素，充满了坚强的自信。

en.t: This solid way of playing was not passive; rather, it concealed active elements and was filled with strong confidence.

units.source_text: 表面上缓慢忍让，实际上内中蕴含力量。

en.t: On the surface it seemed slow and yielding, but in reality it contained strength within.

units.source_text: 因此，既已定下快攻的目标，就不能不相机强攻了。

en.t: Thus, once he had set rapid attack as his aim, he had no choice but to launch a forceful assault when the opportunity arose.
